current_grouping: Subpart H — Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (EWIS)

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H — Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (EWIS)
versions.text: EWIS associated with any installed fire protection system, including those required by Sec. Sec. 25.854 and 25.858, must be considered an integral part of the system in showing compliance with the applicable requirements for that system.
